title: Your Day, Your Timing: Why Jasprit Bumrah Is Backing the Way You Send Money Home With Remitly
summary: Cricketer Jasprit Bumrah is Remitly’s newest brand ambassador. Here’s why he believes people building a life away from home should do it their own way.
body_markdown:
**Your day doesn’t stop for anyone. You work, you study, you look after your own life. And somewhere back home, someone is counting on you.**


**That’s the idea[Jasprit Bumrah is backing as Remitly’s newest brand ambassador.](https://news.remitly.com/company-and-product-news/deliver-your-way-jasprit-bumrah/) People who build a life across borders should be able to do it their own way, on their own timing. That includes sending money home.**


## Why Bumrah


Bumrah grew up in Ahmedabad. His bowling action wasn’t designed by a coach. It grew out of a short car park, a quiet house, and years without anyone telling him how to bowl. He trusted what worked for him and kept going. In December 2024, he became the first bowler to reach 200 Test wickets with a bowling average under 20. That record is built on speed, accuracy, and reliability. Those are the same things people expect when they send money home.


For many families in India, Bumrah is a familiar face.


[https://www.remitly.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/intro_to_amb_4x5_web.mp4](https://www.remitly.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/intro_to_amb_4x5_web.mp4)


## In His Own Words


**“ *I’ve always believed in playing to my strengths and trusting what works for me,*** ” Bumrah says.


“ ***I think that’s something people building a life away from home can relate to. You find your own way, back yourself and keep moving forward.*** ”


He adds that he’s glad to bring that message to life with Remitly, *“ **making fast, safe and reliable money transfers possible for people around the world.*** ”


## What It Means to Send Money Your Way


For a lot of people, sending money home has meant fitting your life around someone else’s process. You wait in line at an agent. You go through a long process at a bank. You plan your day around opening hours, and your family’s day is already under way.


**[The Remitly app](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/mobile-app)** works the other way around. You can[send money to India](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india) digitally, on your own schedule. It’s the same idea Bumrah believes in: **find what works for you, and trust it** .


Vikas Mehta, Remitly’s CFO, put it this way. Bumrah is one of cricket’s well-known fast bowlers because he does things his own way, and he delivers with speed, accuracy, and reliability. Our customers build their lives their own way, too, and those values are at the heart of Remitly.


## For Family on the Other End


Behind every transfer, someone is waiting. Maybe it’s a parent, a sibling, or a friend back home. When you send money to India with Remitly, you choose when it leaves.


### How to Receive Money in India With Remitly


Recipients in India can receive money in different ways, depending on the delivery methods available where they live. These can include cash pickup, bank deposit, and UPI.


The best way to start is to ask your family how they’d like to receive it, then choose that option when you send it. Your recipient doesn’t need to sign up with Remitly to receive money. You, the sender, create the Remitly account.


[Send money to India](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india) with the Remitly app. Know someone who sends you money? Share this with them.


### See It in the Film


Bumrah leads our new global campaign, “Deliver Your Way.” In the film, a man named Prateek, played by Yawar Nazir, copies Bumrah’s bowling action everywhere he goes: in a boardroom, at home, on the high street, and at the bank. It rarely goes well.


When he reaches a money transfer kiosk just as the shutter comes down, Bumrah appears with a simple message: you don’t need to copy anyone to win. You need to do it your own way.


Watch the film, and watch Jasprit Bumrah talk about becoming a Remitly brand ambassador.


[https://www.remitly.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/jb_deliver_your_way_16x9_web.mp4](https://www.remitly.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/jb_deliver_your_way_16x9_web.mp4)


## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


### Who Is Jasprit Bumrah?


Jasprit Bumrah is a fast bowler for India, and he grew up in Ahmedabad. In December 2024, he became the first bowler to reach 200 Test wickets with a bowling average under 20.


### What Is Jasprit Bumrah’s Role With Remitly?


He’s a Remitly brand ambassador and the lead of our global campaign, “Deliver Your Way.”


### Who Made the Film?


It was created with[Bare Bones Collective](https://www.barebonescollective.com/) and directed by Ryan Mendonca.


### Is the Remitly App Available in Hindi?


Yes. The Remitly app is available in 18 languages, including Hindi.


### How Do I Send Money to India With Remitly?


Visit[remitly.com](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/why-jasprit-bumrah-is-backing-the-way-you-send-money-home-with-remitly/remitly.com) or download the Remitly app and sign up. You can send money to India digitally, on your own schedule. Your transfer speed will be shown before you send.


### Do I Have to Go to an Agent or a Bank?


No. With the Remitly app, you can send money home digitally, without waiting in line at an agent or going through a long process at a bank.


### How Does My Family Receive Money in India?


Your family can receive money in different ways, depending on the delivery methods available where they live. These can include cash pickup, mobile money, home delivery, debit card deposit, or deposit directly into a bank account.
